release.headline: Aeroméxico Reports Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Results (record 3Q revenue $1.6bn; op margin 11.7%; 4Q26 op margin guide 7.5-9.5% on $4.5/gal fuel)

vs_bar.consensus_source: company 3Q26 guide midpoint $1.59-1.62bn, 6-K 2026-07-13 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001561861/000119312526302103/d112634dex991.htm (street revenue consensus not reliably sourced; Tickflow $1.55bn per the hunt)
Nasdaq EPS forecast from the brief (fallback, 2 estimates); other vendors range $0.24-0.61 per the hunt
company guide midpoint 26.5-29.5% per the hunt, 6-K 2026-07-13

key_line.detail: 4Q26 op margin ~7.5-9.5% (prior guide 15.5-18.5%), FY26 ~8.5-9.5% (prior 11-13%), adj. EBITDAR 19.5-21.5% 4Q and 21.5-22.5% FY (prior 28-31% and 24-26%). New 4Q fuel assumption ~$4.5/gal all-in (prior $3.0), above the ~$4.25 curve the hunt cited, so the reset looks conservatively sized. 4Q revenue +14-16% y/y, ASMs +7-8%. 3Q fuel was ~$4.0/gal vs $3.2 assumed.

guidance.detail: Margin guide roughly halved for 4Q (midpoint 8.5% vs 17.0%) and FY cut to 9.0% from 12.0% midpoint; revenue growth guide strong (4Q ~+15%). The direction of the cut was expected by the street (fuel curve public); its size is at or beyond the hunt's 9-11pp estimate because the new fuel assumption ($4.5) sits above the curve.

call.detail: Call is Tuesday 2026-10-20 at 10:00 ET (08:00 Mexico City), half an hour into the session. The CEO's release quote is constructive (record revenue, pricing and cost discipline offset fuel, 'resume growth with discipline'), and a fuel assumption of $4.5 above the curve gives management room to sound conservative; the call is more likely to help the stock than hurt it, which is a risk to a short held through it.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines split between 'record revenue' framing (GuruFocus: 'Strong Q3 Revenue Growth Amid High Fuel Costs', StockTitan 'record $1.6B revenue') and profit framing (Bitget: 'net income drops 58%', Quiver: 'Revenue Rises but Profit Falls'). No analyst action found this morning. No retail source found (retail_tone 0 = unknown, not neutral evidence).

tape_read.note: One pre-market print at 15.00 (08:10 ET, high = low = last, zero volume reported), a round number on a thin ADR, so it is a weak read of where the open lands. After-hours last was 16.00 (+0.69%). -5.6% sits inside the 11.4% implied move (an untraded chain, unreliable) but at or beyond every past AERO reaction (-4.9% to +4.8%) and beyond Delta's -3% on its own fuel cut. The guide cut was the expected event; -5.6% already holds a large share of it. Market flat (SPY -0.1%).

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a large fuel-driven Q4/FY margin guide cut with revenue holding up: Q3 margin missed guide (11.7% vs 14-17%), the 4Q margin guide was roughly halved, and revenue landed at the top of guide, exactly the shape the hunt described.

recommendation.reason: De verwachte forse verlaging van de margeverwachting is gekomen en de koers staat voorbeurs al zo'n 5,6% lager, meer dan Aeroméxico na eerdere cijfers en Delta na zijn eigen brandstofverlaging bewogen. De toelichting voor analisten begint om 10:00 ET, midden in de handel, en de directie heeft daar ruimte om positief te klinken (recordomzet, een brandstofaanname boven de huidige prijs); bij amc-namen geeft de koers na de opening historisch iets terug. Dek de short daarom bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel zegt.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 echte voorbeurshandel onder 14,70 verschijnt of analisten hun koersdoel scherp verlagen, kan de daling doorlopen en is een limietorder onder de voorbeurskoers te overwegen.
